papers.title: Honeycomb-Surfels: Compact Hexagonal Primitives for Efficient Scene Rendering and Reconstruction
papers.translated_title: 蜂窝面元：用于高效场景渲染与重建的紧凑六边形图元
papers.author: Prakhar Kaushik
papers.summary: Novel view synthesis and 3D reconstruction have advanced rapidly with radiance fields and splatting, yet their memory and computational demands limit their use in resource-constrained settings. We introduce Hexels: novel planar hexagonal surface elements with a first-order spatial color field for efficient 3D scene and 2D image representation. Hexels exploit locally planar regions with smoothly varying appearance using fewer, larger primitives. Their hexagonal support provides an area- and boundary-efficient domain, while the local color field captures appearance variation within each primitive. Across 34 scenes, Hexels improve PSNR over memory-matched 2DGS by 4.53-7.38 dB across datasets while requiring lower training VRAM. We further ablate Hexels by showing that per primitive, Hexels outperform 2DGS by upto 4.74 dB while using lower training VRAM and having 2.31 times faster FPS. Even in unconstrained settings, Hexels offers complementary quality-memory trade-offs. For efficient 3D surface reconstruction, Hexels reduce error by 28.9% compared with memory-matched 2DGS across 15 DTU scans. On 6 Tanks and Temples surface scenes, Hexels achieves the highest mean F1 among compared methods (34.38%, versus 31.72% for 2DGS). We further also show that Hexels, as a general primitive, improves 2D image representation over Image-GS. Hexels push the Pareto frontier on the quality-efficiency trade-off of surface-aligned primitives.
papers.translated_summary: 新视角合成与三维重建在辐射场和泼溅技术的推动下快速发展，但其内存与计算需求限制了在资源受限环境中的应用。我们提出 Hexels：新型平面六边形表面元素，配备一阶空间颜色场，用于高效的三维场景与二维图像表示。Hexels 利用局部平面区域及平滑变化的外观，使用更少、更大的图元。其六边形支撑提供了面积与边界高效的域，而局部颜色场则捕捉每个图元内的外观变化。在 34 个场景上，Hexels 在多个数据集上将 PSNR 较内存匹配的 2DGS 提升 4.53–7.38 dB，同时所需训练显存更低。我们进一步通过消融实验表明，在单个图元层面，Hexels 较 2DGS 提升最高达 4.74 dB，同时训练显存更低且 FPS 快 2.31 倍。即使在无约束设置下，Hexels 也提供了互补的质量-内存权衡。对于高效三维表面重建，Hexels 在 15 个 DTU 扫描上较内存匹配的 2DGS 将误差降低 28.9%。在 6 个 Tanks and Temples 表面场景上，Hexels 在所比较方法中取得最高平均 F1（34.38%，而 2DGS 为 31.72%）。我们进一步表明，Hexels 作为通用图元，在二维图像表示上优于 Image-GS。Hexels 推动了表面对齐图元在质量-效率权衡上的帕累托前沿。

papers.title: ThinkWorld: World Imagination Reinforces Chain-of-Dynamics Reasoning
papers.translated_title: ThinkWorld：世界想象强化动态链推理
papers.author: Chaehyun Kim
papers.summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have made substantial progress in robotic manipulation, but their generalization remains constrained by the diversity and coverage of action-labeled robot demonstrations. Human videos provide much broader behavioral and environmental experience, while learning from them faces a fundamental trade-off between scalable data and explicit action grounding. We introduce ThinkWorld, a VLA learning framework that grounds action reasoning in world dynamics and strengthens it through reinforcement learning with world imagination. ThinkWorld represents each action thought as a Chain-of-Dynamics (CoD), a sequence of discrete motion tokens that captures the intermediate dynamics connecting the current world to a future state and serves as a common action representation across embodiments. We first initialize CoD with action-labeled demonstrations, then predict the future induced by each CoD and reinforce those whose predictions better match the observed outcome. This enables videos without action annotations to provide direct supervision from observed state transitions, allowing human and robot experience to refine the same reasoning space. Experiments in simulation and on real robots demonstrate effective human-to-robot transfer and strong generalization to unseen tasks and environments.
papers.translated_summary: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作方面已取得实质性进展，但其泛化能力仍受限于动作标注机器人演示的多样性和覆盖范围。人类视频提供了更广泛的行为和环境经验，而从中学习面临可扩展数据与显式动作 grounding 之间的根本性权衡。我们提出 ThinkWorld，一个 VLA 学习框架，将动作推理建立在世界动态之上，并通过世界想象强化学习加以增强。ThinkWorld 将每个动作思维表示为动态链（Chain-of-Dynamics，CoD），即一系列离散运动 token，捕捉连接当前世界与未来状态的中间动态，并作为跨具身形态的通用动作表示。我们首先用动作标注演示初始化 CoD，然后预测每个 CoD 所诱导的未来，并强化那些预测与观测结果更匹配的 CoD。这使得没有动作标注的视频能够从观测到的状态转移中提供直接监督，从而让人类和机器人经验精炼同一推理空间。仿真和真实机器人上的实验证明了有效的人类到机器人迁移，以及对未见任务和环境的强泛化能力。

papers.title: Can Discrete Tokens Serve as Semantically Lossless Representations of Visual Signals?
papers.translated_title: 离散标记能否作为视觉信号的语义无损表示？
papers.author: Jialv Zou
papers.summary: Discrete visual tokens represent vision in a discrete form analogous to language, offering a native interface for multimodal modeling under a shared next-token prediction objective. However, quantization error is widely assumed to cause unavoidable semantic loss, fundamentally limiting the semantic fidelity of discrete visual tokens and positioning continuous visual representations as an intrinsic upper bound. Using multimodal understanding as a proxy for semantic fidelity, we revisit this assumption and find quantization error unreliable, as discrete representations with substantially larger errors can achieve better understanding. Instead, the effective bit budget of discrete indices emerges as a key determinant of downstream performance. However, existing quantizers eventually saturate as additional codebooks contribute progressively less semantic information. As one approach to alleviating this saturation, we introduce Factorized Vector Quantization, which quantizes complementary, fixed-dimensional views of the visual feature with symmetric parallel codebooks. It continues to improve at larger bit budgets, ultimately matching continuous visual representations in multimodal understanding. Trained on industrial-scale multimodal data, our model achieves state-of-the-art performance among discrete-representation models, outperforming UniAR and Emu3-Chat by 22.8% and 59.2%, respectively, on a nine-metric average. To our knowledge, it is also the first discrete-representation model competitive with strong continuous-representation models such as Qwen3-VL, including on fine-grained OCR tasks. We further identify the key principles and a practical recipe enabling this competitiveness. These results and insights support the potential of discrete visual representations to underpin large-scale native multimodal foundation models. Code and models are available at https://github.com/hustvl/FVQ
papers.translated_summary: 离散视觉 token 以类似于语言的离散形式表示视觉，为在共享的下一 token 预测目标下进行多模态建模提供了原生接口。然而，量化误差被广泛认为会导致不可避免的语义损失，从根本上限制了离散视觉 token 的语义保真度，并使连续视觉表示成为内在的上界。我们以多模态理解作为语义保真度的代理指标，重新审视这一假设，发现量化误差并不可靠，因为量化误差大得多的离散表示反而可以实现更好的理解。相反，离散索引的有效比特预算成为下游性能的关键决定因素。然而，现有量化器最终会饱和，因为额外的码本贡献的语义信息逐渐减少。作为缓解这种饱和的一种方法，我们引入因子化向量量化，它使用对称并行码本对视觉特征的互补、固定维度视图进行量化。它在更大的比特预算下持续改进，最终在多模态理解中匹配连续视觉表示。在工业规模多模态数据上训练后，我们的模型在离散表示模型中达到了最先进的性能，在九项指标平均值上分别比 UniAR 和 Emu3-Chat 高出 22.8% 和 59.2%。据我们所知，它也是首个能与 Qwen3-VL 等强连续表示模型竞争的离散表示模型，包括在细粒度 OCR 任务上。我们进一步确定了实现这种竞争力的关键原则和实用方案。这些结果和见解支持离散视觉表示支撑大规模原生多模态基础模型的潜力。代码和模型可在 https://github.com/hustvl/FVQ 获取。

papers.title: When Should We Intervene at Test Time?
papers.translated_title: 我们应在何时于测试阶段进行干预？
papers.author: Jiahao Zhang
papers.summary: Test-time adaptation helps a deployed model respond to changing inputs, but the same intervention can rescue one batch and damage the next. Updating normalization statistics, for example, can improve corrupted images yet fail when a batch contains mostly one class. Average accuracy hides these failures and cannot tell a model when to use an intervention. Target labels can guide this decision, but they are scarce and some choices are already clear. We introduce PORTAL, a controller that chooses when to deploy an intervention, which inputs to label, and when to stop querying. Each available prediction rule is a candidate, and its predictions are fixed before current feedback arrives. Every acquired label therefore evaluates all candidates on the same input. PORTAL combines these shared comparisons and directs queries toward candidates that can still overtake the current leader. It stops when the remaining labels cannot change the choice or when the possible accuracy gain no longer justifies another query. Our analysis links the required feedback to accuracy gaps and shared mistakes, explaining why some choices need much less evidence. Experiments show that this control turns an intervention that loses accuracy overall into a useful choice on selected batches. It prevents severe failures caused by changes in arrival order and preserves gains across complete corruption streams. When a fixed rule already works well, PORTAL uses little feedback to retain its performance. Periodic label checks reveal when past evidence needs refreshing and help the controller recover as conditions change. The acquired labels also train stronger candidates for future batches, and selection brings nearly all of their accuracy gains into deployment. The same feedback therefore improves both the choice made now and the predictions available to later batches.
papers.translated_summary: 测试时自适应帮助已部署模型应对变化的输入，但同样的干预可能挽救一个批次却损害下一个批次。例如，更新归一化统计量可以改善受损图像，但当批次中大多为同一类别时则会失败。平均准确率掩盖了这些失败，也无法告诉模型何时使用干预。目标标签可以指导这一决策，但它们稀缺，且某些选择已经明确。我们提出PORTAL，一个控制器，用于选择何时部署干预、标注哪些输入以及何时停止查询。每个可用的预测规则都是一个候选，其预测在当前反馈到达之前就已固定。因此，每个获取的标签都在同一输入上评估所有候选。PORTAL结合这些共享比较，并将查询引向仍可能超越当前领先者的候选。当剩余标签无法改变选择，或可能的准确率增益不再值得另一次查询时，它便停止。我们的分析将所需反馈与准确率差距和共享错误联系起来，解释为何某些选择需要少得多的证据。实验表明，这种控制将整体上损失准确率的干预转变为在选定批次上的有用选择。它防止了由到达顺序变化引起的严重失败，并在完整的损坏流中保持增益。当固定规则已经表现良好时，PORTAL使用很少的反馈来保持其性能。定期标签检查揭示过去证据何时需要刷新，并帮助控制器在条件变化时恢复。获取的标签还为未来批次训练更强的候选，而选择将几乎所有的准确率增益带入部署。因此，同样的反馈既改善了当前做出的选择，也改善了后续批次可用的预测。

papers.title: Heads of Security: Learned Attention Gates Improve Prompt Injection Robustness
papers.translated_title: 安全负责人：学习到的注意力门控提升提示注入鲁棒性
papers.author: Igor Shilov
papers.summary: We introduce Heads of Security (HoS), a prompt injection defense that enforces instruction-data separation via a small set of learned per-head attention gates. HoS learns how each head should redistribute attention between trusted and untrusted tokens, enabling models to reason over untrusted content without following injected instructions. We evaluate HoS on Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and GPT-OSS-20B. We compare it against SecAlign++, a state-of-the-art finetuning-based defense, and ASIDE, a defense that, like ours, builds instruction-data separation into the model architecture. We show that HoS offers greater robustness to adaptive attacks, better performance on standard utility benchmarks, and matches top performance on standard agentic prompt injection benchmarks. More specifically, the black-box RL-Hammer attack reaches 97% ASR against GPT-OSS-20B and 85% against SecAlign, but only 10% against HoS. Claudini, a state-of-the-art white-box attack, strengthened against HoS through autoresearch, requires 3 times more FLOPs to reach the same ASR on HoS as it does on GPT-OSS-20B or SecAlign. HoS preserves base-model utility across standard multiple-choice benchmarks and prompting setups, whereas SecAlign and ASIDE degrade in few-shot settings. On agentic benchmarks with static attacks, HoS and SecAlign perform similarly and substantially improve the security-utility trade-off over the base model. ASIDE struggles with tool use, achieving only 10% utility. These results show that prompt injection robustness can be achieved and improved through targeted attention interventions.
papers.translated_summary: 我们提出安全负责人（Heads of Security, HoS），一种提示注入防御方法，通过一小组学习到的逐头注意力门控来强制实现指令与数据的分离。HoS 学习每个注意力头应如何在可信与不可信 token 之间重新分配注意力，使模型能够对不可信内容进行推理而不遵循注入的指令。我们在 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 和 GPT-OSS-20B 上评估 HoS。我们将其与 SecAlign++（一种最先进的基于微调的防御方法）以及 ASIDE（一种与我们的方法类似、将指令-数据分离构建到模型架构中的防御方法）进行比较。我们表明，HoS 对自适应攻击具有更强的鲁棒性，在标准效用基准上表现更好，并在标准智能体提示注入基准上达到顶级性能。更具体地说，黑盒 RL-Hammer 攻击对 GPT-OSS-20B 达到 97% 的攻击成功率（ASR），对 SecAlign 达到 85%，但对 HoS 仅达到 10%。Claudini 是一种最先进的白盒攻击，通过自动化研究针对 HoS 进行了强化，其在 HoS 上达到相同 ASR 所需的 FLOPs 是在 GPT-OSS-20B 或 SecAlign 上的 3 倍。HoS 在标准多项选择基准和提示设置中保持基座模型的效用，而 SecAlign 和 ASIDE 在少样本设置下性能下降。在具有静态攻击的智能体基准上，HoS 和 SecAlign 表现相似，并相较于基座模型大幅改善了安全-效用权衡。ASIDE 在工具使用方面表现不佳，仅达到 10% 的效用。这些结果表明，通过有针对性的注意力干预可以实现并提升提示注入的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Attention as Lattice Gauge Theory: Relations Interact Only Through Wilson Loops
papers.translated_title: 注意力作为格点规范理论：关系仅通过威尔逊环相互作用
papers.author: Aakash Sarkar
papers.summary: Relations compose through the entity they share - Alice is Bob's mother and Bob is Carol's father, so Alice is Carol's grandmother - and the order matters, since a father's mother is not a mother's father; verifying a composed relation means closing the loop. We show that if each entity's coordinate frame may be rotated independently (per-entity frame freedom), three things follow. In the pure-gauge sector, relations that share no cycle cannot interact at all. The only gauge-invariant score of a triangle is a class function of its holonomy $H = T_{ij} T_{jk} T_{ki}$ - a Wilson loop. And the only equivariant update of an edge is $U = Ψ(H)\, T_{ij}$ with $Ψ$ conjugation-equivariant. Edge attention by Wilson loops is therefore not one design among many but the unique form the symmetry permits. Three communities hold pieces of this form: the commuting-operator embeddings of knowledge graphs are its abelian (commuting) sector; AlphaFold's triangle update and the Edge Transformer have its shape - an edge updated through the third vertex - without its constraints; and lattice QCD builds it equivariantly on lattices. We instantiate the equivariant sub-family on general relational graphs as holonomy attention. With no training and composition alone, it infers unobserved $S_4$ relations on sparse graphs at 0.88 with a fifth of the edges corrupted, at or slightly below specialist synchronization algorithms, where every commutative architecture is capped at 0.083; its holonomy score flags corrupted triangles at AUC 0.99 where commuting scores are capped at 0.76 by a second selection rule, and it separates clusters without labels.
papers.translated_summary: 关系通过它们共享的实体进行复合——Alice是Bob的母亲，Bob是Carol的父亲，因此Alice是Carol的祖母——并且顺序很重要，因为父亲的母亲不是母亲的父亲；验证一个复合关系意味着闭合环路。我们证明，如果每个实体的坐标框架可以独立旋转（逐实体框架自由度），则有三件事随之而来。在纯规范扇区中，不共享任何循环的关系完全无法相互作用。三角形唯一的规范不变分数是其和乐$H = T_{ij} T_{jk} T_{ki}$的类函数——一个Wilson环。而边的唯一等变更新是$U = Ψ(H)\, T_{ij}$，其中$Ψ$是共轭等变的。因此，通过Wilson环进行的边注意力不是众多设计之一，而是对称性所允许的唯一形式。三个社区持有这种形式的部分：知识图谱的交换算子嵌入是其阿贝尔（交换）扇区；AlphaFold的三角形更新和Edge Transformer具有其形状——通过第三个顶点更新一条边——但没有其约束；而格点QCD在格点上等变地构建了它。我们在一般关系图上实例化等变子族作为和乐注意力。在没有训练且仅靠复合的情况下，它在稀疏图上以五分之一的边被损坏的条件下，以0.88的准确率推断出未观测到的$S_4$关系，达到或略低于专业同步算法，而每个交换架构的上限为0.083；其和乐分数以AUC 0.99标记损坏的三角形，而交换分数因第二条选择规则被限制在0.76，并且它无需标签即可分离聚类。

papers.title: KPPax: preprocess differentiable kinetic ODE for machine learning in atmospheric chemistry
papers.translated_title: KPPax：为大气化学中的机器学习预处理可微动力学ODE
papers.author: Wenqing Peng
papers.summary: Atmospheric chemical mechanisms are commonly distributed in the language of the Kinetic PreProcessor (KPP), which generates efficient Fortran or C code but does not fit into the differentiable programming frameworks in which machine-learning models are developed. We present KPPax, a kinetic preprocessor that generates differentiable, just-in-time compiled, and vectorisable chemistry code in JAX from mechanisms written in the KPP language. KPPax evaluates the rate law with sparse operations in log space, which keeps it differentiable, and integrates the stiff system with the implicit solvers and the forward- and reverse-mode adjoints of the \texttt{diffrax} library, so that exact sensitivities are obtained without hand-derived adjoint code. We demonstrate two applications with the POLLU benchmark mechanism. In the first, the Fisher information matrix computed from an automatically differentiated Jacobian predicts, before any fit, which of the 25 rate coefficients a flow-tube-like design can identify, and noisy synthetic estimation confirms the predicted uncertainties of the nine identifiable rate coefficients to within about 30\% while revealing clusters of fast reactions of which only ratios are constrained. In the second, a neural-network correction of an emission inventory is trained offline on per-scenario 4D-Var retrievals and then fine-tuned online through the chemical model, which reduces the error of the biogenic correction by a factor of 2.4--5 and recovers information on low-temperature emissions that the individual retrievals lose. KPPax makes KPP mechanisms directly usable for parameter estimation and hybrid physics--machine-learning modelling.
papers.translated_summary: 大气化学机理通常以动力学预处理器（KPP）的语言发布，该预处理器可生成高效的 Fortran 或 C 代码，但不适用于开发机器学习模型的可微编程框架。我们提出 KPPax，一种动力学预处理器，可从以 KPP 语言编写的机理出发，在 JAX 中生成可微、即时编译且可向量化的化学代码。KPPax 在对数空间中用稀疏运算计算速率定律，从而保持可微性，并用 \texttt{diffrax} 库的隐式求解器及前向和反向模式伴随对刚性系统进行积分，因此无需手工推导伴随代码即可获得精确灵敏度。我们以 POLLU 基准机理演示了两个应用。第一个应用中，由自动微分雅可比计算得到的 Fisher 信息矩阵在任何拟合之前即可预测类流管设计能够识别 25 个速率系数中的哪些，含噪合成估计将九个可识别速率系数的预测不确定度确认至约 30% 以内，同时揭示出仅其比值受到约束的快速反应簇。第二个应用中，排放清单的神经网络校正先基于逐情景 4D-Var 反演进行离线训练，再通过化学模型进行在线微调，使生物源校正的误差降低 2.4–5 倍，并恢复了个体反演所丢失的低温排放信息。KPPax 使 KPP 机理可直接用于参数估计和物理–机器学习混合建模。

papers.title: Pushing Dexterity and Safety for In-Hand Object Pose Reaching That Works Remarkably Well
papers.translated_title: 推动灵巧性与安全性的手内物体姿态到达方法，效果显著出色
papers.author: Ian Chuang
papers.summary: Dexterous manipulation with multi-fingered hands is the next frontier of robotics, yet learned hand skills remain limited to simple grasps or basic repeated motions, such as rotating an object. As robots attempt more demanding in-hand maneuvers, safety, such as not dropping the object, becomes critical, yet it is rarely measured. We study in-hand object pose reaching, a task that demands diverse and difficult grasps: moving an object to almost any position and orientation within reach of the fingers, at any wrist orientation, through long sequences of consecutive goals. We present a recipe for training such policies for a LEAP hand in simulation without human data, built on a range of insights, from diverse resets and goals via generated grasp datasets to an adaptive friction curriculum. With careful system identification, the policies transfer zero-shot to the real hand, using either motion capture or a single wrist-mounted depth camera, and prove remarkably capable and robust. On top of the task policy, we add a learned residual safety filter with adjustable conservativeness, letting us tune the balance between performance and safety and greatly reduce object drops. In 13.3 hours of real-robot evaluation over 4,800 unseen goals across 4 objects and diverse wrist orientations, the state-based policy reaches 95.2% of goals within 2 cm and 0.4 rad, and the filter cuts its drops by 75% while still reaching 91.5% of goals. The policies can also spin a lightbulb held in an arbitrary pose, reach out-of-distribution goals, withstand fast arm motion and perturbations, and, needing only a wrist camera, serve as portable skills such as screwing in a lightbulb. We release the full recipe as a platform for studying performance, reliability, and safety in high-dimensional dexterous systems. Videos and more are available at https://ian-chuang.github.io/dexsafe/.
papers.translated_summary: 多指灵巧操作是机器人学的下一个前沿，然而已习得的手部技能仍局限于简单抓取或基本重复动作，例如旋转物体。随着机器人尝试更高难度的在手操作，安全性（例如不掉落物体）变得至关重要，但这一点却很少被衡量。我们研究在手物体位姿到达任务，该任务要求多样且困难的抓取：在任意腕部朝向下，通过长序列的连续目标，将物体移动到手指可达范围内的几乎任意位置和朝向。我们提出了一套在仿真中为LEAP手训练此类策略的方案，无需人类数据，该方案建立在多项洞见之上，从通过生成的抓取数据集实现多样化重置与目标，到自适应摩擦课程。通过细致的系统辨识，策略可零样本迁移到真实手部，使用动作捕捉或单个腕部安装的深度相机，并展现出显著的能力与鲁棒性。在任务策略之上，我们添加了一个可学习残差安全滤波器，其保守程度可调，使我们能够调节性能与安全之间的平衡，并大幅减少物体掉落。在13.3小时的真实机器人评估中，覆盖4个物体、多样腕部朝向下的4800个未见目标，基于状态的策略在2厘米和0.4弧度范围内达到95.2%的目标，滤波器将其掉落率降低75%，同时仍达到91.5%的目标。这些策略还能旋转以任意位姿持有的灯泡，到达分布外目标，承受快速手臂运动和扰动，并且仅需一个腕部相机，即可作为便携技能使用，例如拧入灯泡。我们将完整方案作为平台发布，用于研究高维灵巧系统中的性能、可靠性和安全性。视频及更多内容见 https://ian-chuang.github.io/dexsafe/。

papers.title: GEPA-Curator: Curated Learning for Self Improving Agents
papers.translated_title: GEPA-Curator：面向自我改进智能体的精选学习
papers.author: Zack Yu
papers.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in multi-turn agentic workloads that require sustained interaction with complex environments. Existing reflective prompt optimizers such as GEPA learn from failed rollouts, but agentic failures can also come from prompt weaknesses, harness limitations, stochastic execution, or noisy judges. We argue that such failures may not provide useful learning signal, and may even be harmful; and thus it is essential to curate which tasks are provided to the prompt optimizer for better performance. We introduce GEPA-Curator, a framework that augments the prompt optimizer to select which agent experiences should shape prompt optimization. In particular, GEPA-Curator consists of two components: task curation, which filters out tasks that are likely to provide noisy or unreliable learning signals, and prior success retrieval, which selectively retrieves past successful trajectories for a task and provides them as additional context to the prompt optimizer. We evaluate GEPA-Curator on GoBrowse, ALFWorld, AppWorld, and $τ$-bench, using both Gemini 3.1 Pro and Claude Opus 5 as optimizer models. GEPA-Curator matches or exceeds the mean performance of both baselines, with gains of up to 20.7% over GEPA and 21.2% over ACE.
papers.translated_summary: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地用于多轮智能体工作负载，这些负载需要与复杂环境持续交互。现有的反思式提示优化器（如GEPA）从失败的 rollout 中学习，但智能体失败也可能源于提示弱点、执行框架限制、随机执行或带噪声的评判器。我们认为此类失败可能无法提供有用的学习信号，甚至可能有害；因此，必须筛选提供给提示优化器的任务，以获得更好的性能。我们提出 GEPA-Curator，一个增强提示优化器的框架，用于选择哪些智能体经验应塑造提示优化。具体而言，GEPA-Curator 由两个组件组成：任务筛选，过滤掉可能提供噪声或不可靠学习信号的任务；以及先验成功检索，针对某个任务有选择地检索过去成功的轨迹，并将其作为额外上下文提供给提示优化器。我们在 GoBrowse、ALFWorld、AppWorld 和 $τ$-bench 上评估 GEPA-Curator，使用 Gemini 3.1 Pro 和 Claude Opus 5 作为优化器模型。GEPA-Curator 达到或超过两个基线的平均性能，相较 GEPA 提升最高达 20.7%，相较 ACE 提升最高达 21.2%。

papers.title: Can LLMs Uncover Hidden Physical Laws through Free Exploration?
papers.translated_title: 大型语言模型能否通过自由探索揭示隐藏的物理定律？
papers.author: Zhen Yang
papers.summary: Scientific discovery often begins with an unexpected observation that prompts a new research question. In a world with altered physical laws, can large language models (LLMs) notice unexpected behavior, such as heavier objects falling more slowly, and discover the law through experiments without being told what to investigate? To evaluate this ability, we introduce LongChang, an automated framework that creates simulated worlds with altered physics, where one or more laws differ from ordinary physics. The evaluated LLMs act as explorers, manipulating objects and building tools to investigate their own questions without research tasks or hints about these laws. Separate LLM agents generate and review scenes, review tool designs, and evaluate reports for correctness and experimental support using the altered physical laws and exploration records. These records guide scene evolution for further exploration, allowing the full cycle to run without human intervention. Among 12 LLMs, GPT-6-Astra achieves a discovery rate of 16.7%, while the other 11 score 0%. The exploration records reveal uninvestigated anomalies and only partial identification of the altered physical laws.
papers.translated_summary: 科学发现往往始于一个意想不到的观察，进而引出新的研究问题。在一个物理定律被改变的世界中，大型语言模型（LLMs）能否注意到异常行为，例如较重的物体下落得更慢，并在未被告知要研究什么的情况下通过实验发现该定律？为了评估这一能力，我们引入了LongChang，一个自动化框架，它创建具有改变后物理规律的模拟世界，其中一个或多个定律与普通物理不同。被评估的LLMs充当探索者，操纵物体并构建工具来研究自己的问题，而没有研究任务或关于这些定律的提示。独立的LLM智能体生成并审查场景、审查工具设计，并利用改变后的物理定律和探索记录来评估报告的正确性和实验支持。这些记录引导场景演化以进行进一步探索，使整个循环无需人工干预即可运行。在12个LLMs中，GPT-6-Astra达到了16.7%的发现率，而其他11个得分为0%。探索记录揭示了未被调查的异常现象以及对改变后物理定律的部分识别。

papers.title: Mixtures of stably coexisting species overyield
papers.translated_title: 稳定共存物种的混合体产生超产效应
papers.author: Desallais, M.
papers.summary: Diverse plant communities usually produce more biomass than monocultures, an advantage that strengthens over time and is attributed mainly to the complementarity effect - the extra biomass produced, relative to monocultures, when species exploit different resources, share fewer enemies or facilitate one another. Yet whether this advantage is a mere tendency of diverse communities, or something that every persistent community must have, has remained unknown. Here we show that stable coexistence requires a positive complementarity effect, with vanishingly rare exceptions, and that underyielding communities are significantly more likely to lose a species within two years or sampling steps, across four long-term biodiversity experiments, with odds of losing a species nearly three times higher than in other communities. In the twenty-five years since the complementarity effect was defined, the link between biodiversity effects and species coexistence had only been established theoretically for two species in competition or observed as a correlation; our theoretical result makes it a general property of multispecies communities, in which the complementarity effect scales with two established measures of how securely species coexist - local and structural stability. Our analyses are, to our knowledge, the first to test a coexistence prediction - impending species loss - prospectively in biodiversity experiments, from a functioning measure alone, turning a measure of what diversity does into a diagnostic of whether diversity can persist. Stable coexistence and higher productivity are thus intrinsically linked: biodiversity does not merely benefit ecosystem production on average; biodiversity that endures cannot but benefit it through complementarity. We anticipate that this diagnostic will turn existing biodiversity experiments, sown grasslands and intercrops into early-warning systems for species loss, since it requires only the biomass of each species in mixture and in monoculture - data these systems already collect, and that agronomists already combine into the land equivalent ratio - and that it will extend to forests, through the growing networks of tree diversity experiments and mixed-species plantations where the same measurements are made.
papers.translated_summary: 多样的植物群落通常比单一栽培产生更多的生物量，这一优势随时间增强，主要归因于互补效应——即相对于单一栽培，当物种利用不同资源、共享较少敌人或相互促进时所产生的额外生物量。然而，这一优势究竟只是多样群落的一种趋势，还是每一个持久群落都必须具备的特征，一直未知。在此我们表明，稳定的共存需要正的互补效应，例外极为罕见；并且在四项长期生物多样性实验中，产量不足的群落在两年或采样步骤内失去一个物种的可能性显著更高，失去物种的几率比其他群落高出近三倍。在互补效应被定义以来的二十五年里，生物多样性效应与物种共存之间的联系仅在理论上对两个竞争物种建立过，或仅作为相关性被观察到；我们的理论结果使其成为多物种群落的一般性质，其中互补效应与两个已确立的物种共存稳固程度度量——局部稳定性和结构稳定性——成比例。据我们所知，我们的分析是首次在生物多样性实验中前瞻性地检验一个共存预测——即将发生的物种丧失——仅从一个功能度量出发，将一个关于多样性做什么的度量转变为多样性能否持续的诊断。因此，稳定共存与更高生产力本质上是相互关联的：生物多样性并非仅仅平均而言有益于生态系统生产；持续存在的生物多样性必然通过互补效应有益于它。我们预期这一诊断将把现有的生物多样性实验、播种草地和间作转变为物种丧失的早期预警系统，因为它只需要混合物和单一栽培中每个物种的生物量——这些系统已经收集的数据，且农学家已将其合并为土地当量比——并且它将扩展到森林，通过不断增长的树木多样性实验网络和混合物种人工林，那里进行着相同的测量。

papers.title: Beyond the glass: testing visitor effects on the behavior of teleost fish in public aquaria
papers.translated_title: 超越玻璃：测试游客对公共水族馆中硬骨鱼行为的影响
papers.author: Vincent, L.
papers.summary: Zoos and public aquariums serve as essential hubs for wildlife conservation, public education, and scientific research; however, the success of these missions depends upon maintaining high animal welfare standards despite constant human presence. A primary concern is the 'visitor effect': the modification of animal behavior due to human presence. While this phenomenon is well-documented in captive mammals and has been explored in Chondrichthyans, it remains largely unexamined in teleost fish, despite evidence of their sensitivity to human stimuli in natural environments. This study addresses this knowledge gap by investigating the behavioral responses of 13 teleost species to varying levels of visitor density, direct human solicitations, and ambient noise. Our multivariate analysis reveals that the total number of visitors present in the aquarium and the direct sonic human solicitations (such as knocking on the glass) are significant drivers of behavioral changes. We observed high inter-taxonomic variability: while Euxiphipops sextriatus, Dascyllus aruanus, Zebrasoma flavescens, Chaetodontoplus mesoleucus and Pygoplites diacanthus showed marked sensitivity through significant modifications in their behaviors the others (Amphiprion percula, Chaetodon rafflesia, Chromis viridis, Chrysiptera parasema, Heniochus chrysostomus, and Lactoria cornuta) showed no obvious behavioral changes. Furthermore, acoustic analysis indicates a complex soundscape where global visitor density correlates with increased sound amplitude, particularly in the 100 Hz to 400 Hz range, a critical band for teleost hearing, suggesting that visitor-induced noise is distinct from the aquarium's technical background noise (pumps, aerator etc). These findings underscore that the 'visitor effect' is not a uniform phenomenon but a complex interaction shaped by species-specific sensitivity and distinct anthropogenic actions. Our results highlight the necessity of incorporating species-specific behavioral data and acoustic monitoring into welfare management protocols to better mitigate the impact of human presence on captive fish populations.
papers.translated_summary: 动物园和公共水族馆是野生动物保护、公众教育和科学研究的重要枢纽；然而，这些使命的成功取决于在持续人类存在的情况下维持高动物福利标准。一个主要关注点是“游客效应”：即人类存在导致动物行为的改变。虽然这一现象在圈养哺乳动物中已有充分记录，并在软骨鱼类中有所探讨，但在真骨鱼类中仍基本未被研究，尽管有证据表明它们在自然环境中对人类刺激具有敏感性。本研究通过调查13种真骨鱼类对不同游客密度、直接人类挑逗和环境噪声的行为反应，填补了这一知识空白。我们的多变量分析揭示，水族馆内游客总数和直接声学人类挑逗（如敲击玻璃）是行为变化的显著驱动因素。我们观察到高度的跨分类群变异性：Euxiphipops sextriatus、Dascyllus aruanus、Zebrasoma flavescens、Chaetodontoplus mesoleucus和Pygoplites diacanthus通过显著的行为改变表现出明显的敏感性，而其他物种（Amphiprion percula、Chaetodon rafflesia、Chromis viridis、Chrysiptera parasema、Heniochus chrysostomus和Lactoria cornuta）则未表现出明显的行为变化。此外，声学分析表明存在复杂的声景，整体游客密度与声音振幅增加相关，特别是在100 Hz至400 Hz范围内，这是真骨鱼类听觉的关键频段，表明游客引起的噪声与水族馆的技术背景噪声（水泵、增氧机等）不同。这些发现强调，“游客效应”并非统一现象，而是由物种特异性敏感性和不同人为行为共同塑造的复杂相互作用。我们的结果凸显了将物种特异性行为数据和声学监测纳入福利管理协议的必要性，以更好地减轻人类存在对圈养鱼类种群的影响。

papers.title: Goal directed closed-loop training of network bursts in cortical cultures produces improved performance and error correction over days
papers.translated_title: 皮层培养物中网络爆发的目标导向闭环训练在数天内产生性能提升和错误校正
papers.author: Clawson, W.
papers.summary: Dissociated neural cultures are living systems with no evolutionary history in their current form, which makes them a testbed for asking what goals neural tissue can learn to pursue once it is removed from its evolved body. It remains unclear which features of network activity such a culture can be trained to control, and whether that training is retained from one day to the next. We built an open-source closed-loop platform, the Holistic Agential Learning platform (HAL), that detects a network burst on a high-density microelectrode array, estimates its spatial origin in real time, and applies a minimal reinforcement rule. Here, a burst that originates off the goal side triggers global random stimulation that persists until the next burst. Over days of training, rat cortical cultures (n=10) increased the fraction of bursts that initiated on the goal side. This gain accrued between sessions, with little change within a session, a consolidation-like pattern that we interpret as a statement about timescale while the mechanism remains untested. The burst origin moved toward the goal side, while the burst peak and the repertoire of propagation directions were preserved. Trained cultures also recovered from incorrect states more reliably over days, while the rate at which they entered those states was unchanged, and this recovery effect was the most robust difference from unstimulated controls (n=6). Cultures that began on either side of chance converged to a similar level of performance. Damaged cultures (n=6) with comparable burst statistics showed neither the across-day gain nor the consolidation-like pattern. Training reweighted the activity patterns each culture already had, and we saw no new ones, which we read as a simple form of niche construction in which the tissue keeps a trace of its history that biases what it does next. These results identify burst initiation and error recovery as trainable variables in a novel living system, and they support training the tissue rather than engineering the machine.
papers.translated_summary: 解离神经培养物是以其当前形式存在、没有进化历史的生命系统，这使它们成为一个试验平台，用以探究神经组织一旦从其所进化的身体中移除后，能够学会追求哪些目标。目前尚不清楚此类培养物可以被训练控制网络活动的哪些特征，以及这种训练能否从一天保留到第二天。我们构建了一个开源闭环平台——整体能动学习平台（HAL），它能在高密度微电极阵列上检测网络爆发，实时估计其空间起源，并施加一条最小强化规则。在这里，起源于目标侧之外的爆发会触发全局随机刺激，该刺激持续到下一次爆发。经过数天的训练，大鼠皮层培养物（n=10）提高了在目标侧起始的爆发比例。这一增益在会话之间累积，而在会话内变化很小，这是一种类似巩固的模式，我们将其解读为关于时间尺度的陈述，但其机制尚未经过检验。爆发起源向目标侧移动，而爆发峰值和传播方向库得以保留。经过训练的培养物在数天内还能更可靠地从错误状态中恢复，而它们进入这些状态的速率保持不变，这种恢复效应是与未受刺激对照组（n=6）相比最稳健的差异。起始于随机水平两侧的培养物收敛到相似的性能水平。具有可比爆发统计特征的受损培养物（n=6）既未表现出跨天增益，也未表现出类似巩固的模式。训练重新加权了每个培养物已有的活动模式，我们没有看到新的模式，我们将其解读为一种简单形式的生态位构建，即组织保留其历史的痕迹，从而偏置其下一步的行为。这些结果将爆发起始和错误恢复识别为一个新型生命系统中可训练的变量，并且它们支持训练组织而非工程化机器。

papers.title: A longitudinal naturalistic fMRI study of trait anxiety and cross-phase consistency in subjective fear signature expression
papers.translated_title: 一项关于特质焦虑与主观恐惧特征表达跨阶段一致性的纵向自然主义fMRI研究
papers.author: Chen, C.-L. W.
papers.summary: Persistent fear is a central feature of anxiety, but it remains unclear whether this persistence is more closely related to the consistency of conditioned-threat processing or to the consistency of subjectively experienced fear. Using a longitudinal naturalistic viewing fMRI paradigm, we examined whether trait anxiety was associated with cross-phase consistency in the expression of two validated fear-related neural signatures. Forty-two participants completed two fMRI phases separated by approximately three months, viewing the same 18 naturalistic videos followed by a resting-state segment, resulting in 19 analysis segments for cross-phase analyses. We applied two pre-trained signatures of subjective fear and threat conditioning, independently developed by separate research groups, to estimate their expression over time and examined how consistently each signature was reexpressed across phases within participants. We found that higher trait anxiety was significantly associated with greater cross-phase consistency in subjective-fear signature expression, with a significantly stronger association than for threat-conditioning signature expression. The anxiety-consistency association was also stronger for the subjective-fear signature than for a general negative-affect signature. This association became more prominent over longer temporal windows and was not detected in the average time series of the amygdala, ventromedial prefrontal cortex, insula, or hippocampus. These findings suggest that individual differences in trait anxiety are associated with the consistent cross-phase reexpression of distributed neural patterns related to subjective fear. Taken together, this study demonstrates how predictive brain models combined with longitudinal naturalistic viewing can provide a new approach for examining individual differences in trait anxiety across repeated experiences of the same naturalistic contexts.
papers.translated_summary: 持续的恐惧是焦虑的核心特征，但这种持续性究竟更密切地关联于条件性威胁加工的一致性，还是更密切地关联于主观体验恐惧的一致性，目前仍不清楚。本研究采用纵向自然观看fMRI范式，考察特质焦虑是否与两种经效度验证的恐惧相关神经特征在跨阶段表达上的一致性有关。42名参与者完成了相隔约三个月的两个fMRI阶段，观看相同的18段自然视频，随后是静息态片段，最终得到19个分析片段用于跨阶段分析。我们应用了由不同研究小组独立开发的主观恐惧和威胁条件化的两种预训练特征，以估计它们随时间推移的表达，并考察每种特征在参与者内部跨阶段被重新表达的稳定程度。我们发现，较高的特质焦虑与主观恐惧特征表达的跨阶段一致性显著相关，且这种关联显著强于威胁条件化特征表达。焦虑与一致性之间的关联在主观恐惧特征上也强于一般负性情感特征。这种关联在更长的时间窗口内变得更加突出，并且在杏仁核、腹内侧前额叶皮层、脑岛或海马的平均时间序列中未被检测到。这些发现表明，特质焦虑的个体差异与主观恐惧相关的分布式神经模式在跨阶段的一致重新表达有关。综上所述，本研究表明，预测性脑模型结合纵向自然观看可以为考察特质焦虑在重复体验相同自然情境中的个体差异提供一种新方法。

papers.title: Mental Timing in Locomotion: Walking Across Real and Imagined Distances
papers.translated_title: 运动中的心理计时：跨越真实与想象距离的行走
papers.author: Van Caenegem, E. E.
papers.summary: The present study aimed to directly replicate the seminal findings of Decety et al. (1989), while also extending the original work with a larger sample size and additional statistical analyses. Thirty healthy adults completed both imagined and executed walking tasks over distances of 5, 10, and 15 meters. Participants also completed the Movement Imagery Questionnaire 3 (MIQ 3). Temporal correspondence between imagined and executed walking was assessed using repeated-measures ANOVA, correlation analyses, Bayesian equivalence tests, and Bland Altman analyses. Walking duration increased significantly with distance, while no significant differences were observed between imagined and executed walking times. Bayesian equivalence tests provided evidence supporting temporal equivalence between the two modalities, and Bland Altman analyses indicated good agreement with minimal systematic bias. Strong positive correlations were found between imagined and executed durations at all distances. MIQ-3 scores were not significantly associated with differences between imagined and executed walking durations. Overall, the findings successfully replicate and extend the original results reported by Decety et al. (1989), providing additional evidence supporting temporal equivalence between motor imagery and movement execution. By combining a larger sample size with contemporary statistical approaches, the present study strengthens support for the principle of functional equivalence for highly automated and cyclic movements.
papers.translated_summary: 本研究旨在直接重复Decety等人(1989)的开创性发现，同时通过更大的样本量和额外的统计分析来扩展原始工作。三十名健康成年人完成了距离为5米、10米和15米的想象和实际行走任务。参与者还完成了运动想象问卷3(MIQ 3)。采用重复测量方差分析、相关分析、贝叶斯等价检验和Bland Altman分析评估想象行走与实际行走之间的时间对应关系。行走持续时间随距离显著增加，而想象行走时间与实际行走时间之间未观察到显著差异。贝叶斯等价检验提供了支持两种模态之间时间等价性的证据，Bland Altman分析表明两者具有良好的一致性且系统偏差极小。在所有距离上，想象持续时间与实际持续时间之间均发现强正相关。MIQ-3得分与想象行走和实际行走持续时间之间的差异无显著关联。总体而言，研究结果成功重复并扩展了Decety等人(1989)报告的原始结果，提供了支持运动想象与运动执行之间时间等价性的额外证据。通过结合更大的样本量和当代统计方法，本研究加强了对高度自动化且周期性运动的功能等价原则的支持。

papers.title: Secretory ferritins mediate iron delivery during magnetite tooth formation in chitons
papers.translated_title: 分泌铁蛋白介导石鳖磁铁矿牙齿形成过程中的铁递送
papers.author: Onishi, R.
papers.summary: Iron is essential to most organisms, yet unbound iron is toxic, necessitating tight regulation of its storage and transport. Chitons concentrate extraordinary amounts of iron in radular tissue to form magnetite-mineralized teeth, but how iron is supplied to developing teeth remains unclear. Here, synchrotron radiation X-ray fluorescence mapping resolved the spatiotemporal redistribution of iron from the radular epithelium toward developing teeth. Integrated transcriptomic and proteomic analyses identified secretory ferritin subunits in radular tissue whose genes were highly expressed in the midgut gland and whose proteins were also present in the hemolymph. In vivo fluorescence tracking showed that circulating ferritin was selectively taken up by the radular epithelium, and following injection of Ag-loaded hemolymph ferritin, Ag was detected in developing teeth. Together, these findings support a model in which secretory ferritins produced in the midgut gland transport iron through the hemolymph to the radula, enabling the pronounced iron accumulation required for tooth mineralization.
papers.translated_summary: 铁对大多数生物体至关重要，但游离铁具有毒性，因此需要对其储存和运输进行严格调控。石鳖在齿舌组织中富集大量铁以形成磁铁矿矿化牙齿，但铁如何被供应至发育中的牙齿仍不清楚。本研究利用同步辐射X射线荧光成像解析了铁从齿舌上皮向发育中牙齿的时空再分布。整合转录组和蛋白质组分析鉴定出齿舌组织中的分泌型铁蛋白亚基，其基因在中肠腺中高表达，其蛋白质也存在于血淋巴中。体内荧光追踪显示循环铁蛋白被齿舌上皮选择性摄取，且在注射载银血淋巴铁蛋白后，发育中的牙齿中检测到银。综上，这些发现支持一个模型：中肠腺产生的分泌型铁蛋白通过血淋巴将铁运输至齿舌，从而实现牙齿矿化所需的显著铁积累。

papers.title: Molecular basis of mitogen-activated protein kinase ERK2 activation by its upstream kinase MEK1
papers.translated_title: 丝裂原活化蛋白激酶ERK2被其上游激酶MEK1激活的分子基础
papers.author: von Velsen, J.
papers.summary: The RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK) pathway relays extracellular signals into a cellular response and its dysregulation leads to many pathologies, particularly cancer. Much is known about the individual components of the pathway, however, details of their interactions and how specificity is maintained is still poorly understood. Here, we determined cryo-EM structures of the MAP2K MEK1 activating its substrate MAPK ERK2, the final event in the cascade. We define the molecular details of specificity and activation of ERK2 and examine the mechanism of substrate recognition using solution techniques and molecular dynamics. Binding of the substrate MAPK leads to release of the MAP2K catalytic machinery, a mechanism enhanced in many gain of function disease mutations. Further, we observe that ERK2 release is not required for nucleotide exchange, suggesting how a processive mechanism could proceed. Our data advance the understanding of MAPK signalling specificity and provide a starting point for drug development.
papers.translated_summary: RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK丝裂原活化蛋白激酶（MAPK）通路将细胞外信号传递为细胞反应，其失调会导致许多疾病，尤其是癌症。该通路各组成部分已被广泛了解，然而，它们之间相互作用的细节以及特异性如何维持仍知之甚少。在此，我们测定了MAP2K MEK1激活其底物MAPK ERK2的冷冻电镜结构，这是级联反应中的最后事件。我们明确了ERK2特异性和激活的分子细节，并利用溶液技术和分子动力学研究了底物识别机制。底物MAPK的结合导致MAP2K催化机器的释放，这一机制在许多功能获得性致病突变中增强。此外，我们观察到ERK2的释放并非核苷酸交换所必需，这提示了一种持续性机制可能如何进行。我们的数据推进了对MAPK信号特异性的理解，并为药物开发提供了起点。

papers.title: A rare pre-existing progenitor-like Primed SMC compartment is the dominant inferred source of SMC-derived cellularity in vascular injury and atherosclerosis
papers.translated_title: 一个罕见的预先存在的祖细胞样Primed SMC区室是血管损伤和动脉粥样硬化中SMC衍生细胞性的主要推断来源
papers.author: Wani, S.
papers.summary: The contribution of pre-existing smooth muscle cell (SMC) states to vascular lesions remains unresolved. Here we identify a rare, progenitor-like Primed SMC compartment before lesion formation in sham-operated carotid arteries and across Myh11-lineage marked mouse aortic datasets, with a Primed-like counterpart in non-diseased human aorta. Primed SMCs retain SMC identity while combining attenuated contractile programmes with conserved niche-associated (Cd34, Fst, Tnfrsf11b) and matricellular (Vcam1, Thbs1, Timp1) cores, overlaid by vessel-specific developmental signatures (Nrn1, Gdf10, Scx). After carotid ligation and during high-fat diet-induced atherosclerosis in Ldlr-/- and Apoe-/- mice, disease-associated Primed, cycling and fibrochondrocyte populations preferentially map to baseline Primed SMCs, whereas contractile SMCs are depleted as inferred feeder sources. Concordant trajectory, graph-based and cross-dataset analyses support a model in which this pre-existing compartment is the dominant inferred source of SMC-derived lesional cellularity. These findings favour expansion and diversification of the Primed compartment over widespread phenotypic switching of contractile SMCs.
papers.translated_summary: 已有的平滑肌细胞（SMC）状态对血管病变的贡献仍未明确。在此，我们在假手术颈动脉中、在病变形成之前，鉴定出一个罕见的、类祖细胞的Primed SMC区室，并在Myh11谱系标记的小鼠主动脉数据集中得到验证，同时在非病变人主动脉中发现了类Primed的对应群体。Primed SMC保留SMC身份，同时将减弱的收缩程序与保守的微环境相关核心（Cd34、Fst、Tnfrsf11b）和基质细胞核心（Vcam1、Thbs1、Timp1）相结合，并叠加血管特异性发育特征（Nrn1、Gdf10、Scx）。在颈动脉结扎后以及Ldlr-/-和Apoe-/-小鼠高脂饮食诱导的动脉粥样硬化过程中，疾病相关的Primed、循环和纤维软骨细胞群体优先映射到基线Primed SMC，而收缩型SMC则被耗竭，并据推断作为供给来源。一致的轨迹分析、基于图的分析和跨数据集分析支持这样一个模型：这一预先存在的区室是SMC来源病变细胞性的主要推断来源。这些发现支持Primed区室的扩增和多样化，而非收缩型SMC的广泛表型转换。

papers.title: Microbial profiling of Drosophila in French Guiana reveals candidate microbial taxa associated with native and invasive host.
papers.translated_title: 法属圭亚那果蝇的微生物谱分析揭示了与本地和入侵宿主相关的候选微生物类群。
papers.author: Laffargue, T. T.
papers.summary: Invasive alien species (IAS) represent a major threat to biodiversity, human health, and economy. Yet the role of host-associated microbiomes in invasion processes remains poorly understood in natural systems. Here, we investigated the bacterial and fungal microbiomes of IAS and native Drosophila species collected along an anthropization gradient in French Guiana. Analyses of Drosophila communities revealed that IAS establishment is limited outside coastal habitats. Using bacterial 16S rRNA and fungal ITS metabarcoding of pooled individuals, we assessed microbial diversity, composition, and structure across host species, host category (invasive vs. native), and locality. Bacterial communities associated with IAS harboured reduced alpha diversity and distinct community structure compared to native Drosophila species, and host phylogenetic relatedness and locality also contributed to bacteriome variation. In contrast, fungal communities were mainly structured by locality and host species. We further identified core and exclusive taxa, compared bacteriome composition between native and IAS hosts using global reference datasets, and integrated information from the microbiome literature. This approach led to the identification of 45 bacterial and fungal candidate taxa potentially associated with host adaptation or competitiveness across coastal and rainforest environments. Overall, our results highlight microbiome variation as a potential component of invasion dynamics in Neotropical Drosophila.
papers.translated_summary: 外来入侵物种（IAS）对生物多样性、人类健康和经济构成重大威胁。然而，宿主相关微生物组在入侵过程中的作用在自然系统中仍知之甚少。在此，我们研究了在法属圭亚那沿人类活动梯度采集的入侵物种与本地果蝇物种的细菌和真菌微生物组。对果蝇群落的分析表明，入侵物种的定殖在沿海栖息地之外受到限制。通过对混合个体进行细菌16S rRNA和真菌ITS宏条形码分析，我们评估了跨宿主物种、宿主类别（入侵种与本地种）和地点的微生物多样性、组成和结构。与本地果蝇物种相比，与入侵物种相关的细菌群落表现出较低的α多样性和独特的群落结构，且宿主系统发育相关性和地点也对细菌组变异有贡献。相比之下，真菌群落主要由地点和宿主物种决定。我们进一步鉴定了核心和独有分类群，利用全球参考数据集比较了本地宿主与入侵宿主的细菌组组成，并整合了微生物组文献中的信息。该方法识别出45个细菌和真菌候选分类群，这些分类群可能与沿海和雨林环境中的宿主适应或竞争力相关。总体而言，我们的结果突显了微生物组变异作为新热带果蝇入侵动态的一个潜在组成部分。

papers.title: Technology solutions for immune loci: integrated high-resolution KIR genotyping reveals allelic, structural, and KIR-HLA diversity across 24 human populations
papers.translated_title: 免疫位点的技术解决方案：整合高分辨率KIR基因分型揭示24个人类群体中的等位基因、结构及KIR-HLA多样性
papers.author: Pyo, C.-W.
papers.summary: High-resolution genotyping of killer cell immunoglobulin-like receptor (KIR) genes remains challenging because of extensive sequence homology, copy-number variation, and complex haplotype structures. Although KIR allelic variation influences receptor expression and function, routine typing has largely been limited to gene presence or absence. Here, we evaluated an integrated short-read sequencing system combining a four-reaction, two-stage multiplex PCR assay (ScisGo-KIR-v3), centralized cloud-based copy-aware allele analysis, and interactive genotype review. The system was applied to 2,298 individuals representing 24 populations from the 1000 Genomes Project, with matched high-resolution HLA class I genotypes. Independent validation against complete, phased PacBio KIR sequences from 48 samples demonstrated 98.6% automated copy-number concordance and 92.8% combined copy-number and allele concordance across 768 gene-sample comparisons. Following desktop review, all evaluated assignments were concordant with the reference sequences. In a separate comparison of four computational genotyping methods involving 311 shared samples, the automated Scisco pipeline showed the lowest overall mismatch with the four-method consensus (1.62%). Population analyses identified substantial allele diversity and distinct centromeric and telomeric haplotype-motif distributions. Although exact haplotype pairs were frequently ambiguous, structural assignments became increasingly resolvable at the motif level, and motif backgrounds exhibited characteristic allele compositions. Paired KIR and HLA analysis revealed inherited receptor-ligand configurations concealed by gene-content typing. Among 1,401 KIR3DL1/HLA-B Bw4 co-carriers, 57 lacked an allele annotated for ordinary surface expression, while 457 of 1,175 KIR2DS4 co-carriers of six specified HLA-C allotypes carried only truncated receptor forms. Allele-specific KIR2DL1 and KIR2DS5 classifications further distinguished receptor properties and published ligand-binding annotations that varied among populations. Although potential receptor-ligand repertoire composition differed across populations, analyses did not establish preferential KIR-HLA genetic association after accounting for population structure and multiple testing. Together, these findings demonstrate that integrated short-read KIR genotyping can provide scalable, high-resolution allele and copy-number information while explicitly retaining uncertainty in inferred haplotype structures. Compatibility with established HLA laboratory workflows provides a practical foundation for incorporating allele-resolved KIR analysis into immunogenetic research and future clinical investigations.
papers.translated_summary: 杀伤细胞免疫球蛋白样受体（KIR）基因的高分辨率基因分型仍然具有挑战性，原因在于广泛的序列同源性、拷贝数变异以及复杂的单倍型结构。尽管KIR等位基因变异影响受体表达和功能，常规分型在很大程度上仍局限于基因的存在或缺失。在此，我们评估了一套集成短读长测序系统，该系统结合了四反应、两阶段多重PCR检测（ScisGo-KIR-v3）、集中式云端拷贝感知等位基因分析以及交互式基因型审查。该系统应用于代表1000基因组计划中24个人群的2,298名个体，并配有匹配的高分辨率HLA I类基因型。针对48份样本的完整、定相PacBio KIR序列进行独立验证，在768项基因-样本比较中证明了98.6%的自动化拷贝数一致性和92.8%的拷贝数与等位基因联合一致性。经过桌面审查后，所有评估的判定均与参考序列一致。在涉及311份共享样本的四种计算基因分型方法的单独比较中，自动化Scisco流程与四方法共识的总体不一致率最低（1.62%）。人群分析识别出大量的等位基因多样性以及着丝粒端和端粒端单倍型基序的独特分布。尽管确切的单倍型对经常存在歧义，但结构判定在基序水平上变得越来越可解析，且基序背景表现出特征性的等位基因组成。配对的KIR和HLA分析揭示了被基因内容分型所掩盖的遗传性受体-配体配置。在1,401名KIR3DL1/HLA-B Bw4共携带者中，57名缺乏注释为普通表面表达的等位基因，而在1,175名六种特定HLA-C同种异型的KIR2DS4共携带者中，457名仅携带截短型受体形式。等位基因特异性的KIR2DL1和KIR2DS5分类进一步区分了受体特性及已发表的配体结合注释，这些在不同人群中存在差异。尽管潜在的受体-配体库组成在不同人群间存在差异，但在考虑人群结构和多重检验后，分析并未确立优先的KIR-HLA遗传关联。总之，这些发现表明集成短读长KIR基因分型能够提供可扩展的高分辨率等位基因和拷贝数信息，同时明确保留推断单倍型结构中的不确定性。与现有HLA实验室工作流程的兼容性为将等位基因解析的KIR分析纳入免疫遗传学研究和未来临床研究提供了实用基础。

papers.title: Gene-gene and Gene-Environment Interactions Improve Genetic Risk Predictions for Complex Diseases
papers.translated_title: 基因-基因和基因-环境交互作用改善复杂疾病的遗传风险预测
papers.author: Multerer, K.
papers.summary: Polygenic risk scores (PRS) assume additive SNP effects, yet genetic risk also arises from interactions between loci and environmental factors that contribute to broad-sense heritability. We developed an extended PRS (ePRS) framework for type 2 diabetes (T2D) that incorporates locus-by-locus non-additive effects beyond those captured by additive single-locus PRS or linkage disequilibrium (LD) tagging. These were modelled as interaction-informed cumulative burden (G+G; summed allele counts), epistasis-screened (GxG; allele count products), and gene-environment effects derived from cardiometabolic variables in electronic health records. Across 235,000 UK Biobank participants, five complementary ePRS models captured largely non-overlapping high-risk individuals, suggesting that a key to individual risk predictions comprises the inclusion of multiple interaction-driven biological components rather than a single signal. A composite score was predictive over traditional additive PRS and predictive of T2D among individuals whose clinical symptoms fall within normal ranges.
papers.translated_summary: 多基因风险评分（PRS）假定SNP效应为加性，然而遗传风险也源于位点之间以及与环境因素的交互作用，这些因素共同贡献了广义遗传力。我们针对2型糖尿病（T2D）开发了一个扩展PRS（ePRS）框架，该框架纳入了逐位点非加性效应，这些效应超出了加性单位点PRS或连锁不平衡（LD）标记所捕获的范围。这些效应被建模为交互信息累积负担（G+G；等位基因计数之和）、上位性筛选（GxG；等位基因计数乘积）以及源自电子健康记录中心脏代谢变量的基因-环境效应。在235,000名英国生物银行参与者中，五种互补的ePRS模型捕获了基本不重叠的高风险个体，这表明个体风险预测的关键在于纳入多个交互驱动的生物学组分，而非单一信号。一个复合评分在预测性能上优于传统加性PRS，并能在临床症状处于正常范围内的个体中预测T2D。

papers.title: A Unified Flexible Large Polysomnography Model for Sleep Staging and Downstream Clinical Screening
papers.translated_title: 统一灵活的大型多导睡眠图模型用于睡眠分期和下游临床筛查
papers.author: Deng, G.
papers.summary: Polysomnography (PSG) is central to sleep medicine, yet its analysis remains hindered by labor-intensive manual scoring and limited cross-center generalizability. We present LPSGM, a large-scale PSG model trained on 220,500 hours of data from 16 public datasets (24,000 recordings) that addresses two challenges: cross-center sleep staging generalization and PSG-based screening of narcolepsy, obstructive sleep apnea (OSA), and depression. LPSGM integrates domain-adaptive pre-training, flexible channel configurations, and a unified architecture to accommodate heterogeneous recording protocols. In prospective validation, LPSGM achieves expert-level sleep staging ({kappa} = 0.845 {+/-} 0.066 vs. inter-expert {kappa} = 0.850 {+/-} 0.102) and matches fully supervised models on independent private cohorts. For downstream screening, LPSGM achieves 84.2% accuracy ({kappa} = 0.761) in three-class narcolepsy classification, with cross-institutional transfer for normal-versus-abnormal hypersomnia yielding an AUC of 0.879. Severe OSA screening reaches an AUC of 0.874 without access to respiratory signals. Depression symptom screening achieves an AUC of 0.801 in a surrogate-labeled APPLES cohort, and cross-dataset transfer to an independent clinically diagnosed cohort reaches an AUC of 0.965. These results suggest that LPSGM's pre-trained representations capture sleep-related signatures that generalize across institutions and support PSG-based screening of clinically relevant conditions. The code and pre-trained model are publicly available at https://github.com/Deng-GuiFeng/LPSGM.
papers.translated_summary: 多导睡眠图（PSG）是睡眠医学的核心，然而其分析仍受限于劳动密集型的人工判读以及有限的跨中心泛化能力。我们提出LPSGM，一个大规模PSG模型，基于来自16个公开数据集（24,000份记录）的220,500小时数据训练而成，旨在解决两个挑战：跨中心睡眠分期泛化以及基于PSG的发作性睡病、阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA）和抑郁症筛查。LPSGM整合了领域自适应预训练、灵活的通道配置和统一架构，以适应异构的记录方案。在前瞻性验证中，LPSGM达到专家级睡眠分期水平（{kappa} = 0.845 {+/-} 0.066，专家间{kappa} = 0.850 {+/-} 0.102），并在独立私有队列上匹配全监督模型。在下游筛查方面，LPSGM在三分类发作性睡病分类中达到84.2%的准确率（{kappa} = 0.761），跨机构迁移用于正常与异常嗜睡症判别时AUC为0.879。重度OSA筛查在无法获取呼吸信号的情况下达到AUC 0.874。抑郁症状筛查在替代标签的APPLES队列中达到AUC 0.801，跨数据集迁移至独立临床诊断队列时AUC达到0.965。这些结果表明，LPSGM的预训练表征捕获了可跨机构泛化的睡眠相关特征，并支持基于PSG的临床相关疾病筛查。代码和预训练模型已公开于https://github.com/Deng-GuiFeng/LPSGM。

papers.title: Familial factors inflate the estimated effects of genetic liability to ADHD on behavioural outcomes
papers.translated_title: 家族因素会夸大ADHD遗传易感性对行为结果的估计效应
papers.author: Crick, D. C. P.
papers.summary: Background: People with ADHD have worse health, behavioural and social outcomes, widely interpreted as evidence that ADHD causes these harms, justifying early identification and treatment. But ADHD clusters in families, and conventional studies cannot separate the effect of a person's own ADHD from the family environment in which it arises. We used a family-based genetic design to distinguish the two. Methods: We used up to 22 genome-wide significant variants associated with ADHD (38,691 cases, 186,843 controls) to estimate effects of genetic liability to ADHD on 16 health and behavioural outcomes. We compared population-based estimates with family-based estimates from within-sibship analyses of up to 164,220 siblings. We tested for heterogeneity between the designs, and applied sensitivity analyses. We involved individuals with lived experience of ADHD in interpreting the findings and shaping how the clinical/public-health implications were described. Findings: Population-based analyses implied that greater genetic liability to ADHD increased smoking, alcohol use and depressive symptoms, and reduced educational attainment, age at first child and cognitive performance. In family-based analyses, these effects attenuated. For example, the effect on number of depressive symptoms fell from 0.059 SD (95% CI 0.039, 0.080) to 0.002 SD (-0.052, 0.055), and age at first child increased from -0.045 SD (-0.058, -0.033) to 0.003 SD (-0.040, 0.047), with significant differences between designs (p=0.048 and p=0.034). Findings were consistent across sensitivity analyses. Interpretation: Much of the excess health and behavioural burden attributed to ADHD may reflect the family and environmental context in which ADHD occurs, rather than an individual's own ADHD. Interventions targeting the individual might not reduce these outcomes as much as expected. Distinguishing such effects requires family-based designs. papers.title: Clinical Significance and Distribution of Cerebrospinal Fluid Type IV Oligoclonal Band Pattern in Neurological Disorders: A Retrospective Analysis

papers.summary: Background and Objectives: To characterize the clinical features and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) findings of patients exhibiting a type IV oligoclonal band (OCB) pattern, defined by the presence of identical IgG bands in both CSF and serum. Methods: This retrospective observational study included all consecutive adult patients with a type IV pattern detected during routine CSF analysis at Geneva University Hospitals in 2023. Demographic, clinical, and laboratory data were collected through chart review. Results: A total of 178 patients were included. The mean age was 60.2 years (SD 16.5), and 51.7% were female. The type IV pattern was most frequently observed in non-inflammatory neurological diseases (NIND) (n=103, 57.9%). Other inflammatory neurological diseases accounted for 37 cases (20.7%), multiple sclerosis was identified in 8 patients (4.5%), and peripheral nervous system disorders were present in 20 patients (11.2%). Systemic inflammatory comorbidities were observed in 40 patients (22.5%). An elevated albumin quotient was present in 73 patients (41%) and was most common among those with CNS infections, aseptic meningitis, CNS neoplastic diseases, and peripheral nervous system disorder. Repeated CSF analyses demonstrated temporal fluctuations in the type IV pattern in some patients, without corresponding changes in diagnosis. Discussion: The type IV pattern is predominantly associated with NIND and is relatively uncommon in multiple sclerosis. Although it may reflect systemic immune activation and/or blood brain barrier dysfunction in certain inflammatory conditions, its clinical significance remains nonspecific. These findings support cautious interpretation of the type IV pattern in routine clinical practice.

papers.title: Educational expectations and needs of individuals scheduled for breast surgery within the Primary Nursing Model: a qualitative study
papers.translated_title: 在初级护理模式下，计划接受乳腺手术的个体的教育期望和需求：一项定性研究
papers.author: Sciscioli, M.
papers.summary: Background. A diagnosis of breast cancer may represent a potentially destabilizing event, with significant physical, psychological, and social implications. Individuals scheduled for breast surgery require clear, understandable, and personalized information to prepare for surgery and manage the postoperative period. However, a discrepancy may arise between perceived informational needs and the information actually received. The Primary Nursing model, based on continuity of care and the presence of a designated primary nurse, may promote greater personalization of nurse-led patient education. Aim. To explore the experiences of individuals scheduled for breast surgery in relation to the nurse-led patient education received throughout the perioperative pathway, in order to understand their educational expectations, informational needs, and perceptions of the usefulness of the educational interventions provided within the Primary Nursing model. Design. A qualitative study with a phenomenological orientation. Methods. The study will be conducted at the European Institute of Oncology. Participants will be recruited through convenience sampling among individuals diagnosed with breast cancer who have undergone surgery and received the nurse-led discharge education routinely provided. Approximately 20 participants are expected to be enrolled; the final sample size will be determined according to the principle of data saturation. Data will be collected through semi-structured interviews conducted approximately two weeks after discharge by a member of the research team who is not involved in the participants Clinical care. The interviews, lasting approximately 30-40 minutes, will be audio-recorded with prior consent, transcribed verbatim, and assigned a sequential identification code. Sociodemographic data and clinical information extracted from the medical records will also be collected. The transcripts will be analyzed using thematic analysis according to Braun and Clarke, with a phenomenological orientation. Expected contribution. The study may contribute to understanding potential discrepancies between educational expectations, informational needs, and the perceived usefulness of the information received, thereby informing clinical practice toward personalized educational interventions consistent with continuity of care.

papers.title: Statistical Analysis Plan for the REDEP study: Effectiveness of dual-mobility cups for preventing dislocation after primary total hip arthroplasty by a posterolateral approach compared to unipolar cups in elderly patients
papers.translated_title: REDEP研究统计分析计划：后外侧入路初次全髋关节置换术中双动髋臼杯与单极髋臼杯在老年患者中预防脱位有效性的比较
papers.author: Hoonhout, O.
papers.summary: Periprosthetic hip dislocation is a frequent complication after primary total hip arthroplasty. Observational studies suggest that dual mobility cups may reduce dislocation risk to approximately 1%, but definitive randomized evidence supporting their routine use in primary total hip arthroplasty is absent. The REDEP trial is the first prospective, randomized controlled trial that compares dual mobility cups with unipolar cups in patients [≥]70 years who electively undergo primary total hip arthroplasty via a posterolateral approach. The primary objective of the trial is to determine the difference in the number of patients who suffer a periprosthetic dislocation of the hip within 1 year after primary total hip arthroplasty in this population. Other outcomes include the difference in the total number of hip dislocations (including recurrent dislocations within patients), differences in patient-reported outcome measures, and differences in the incidence of (serious) adverse events. This statistical analysis plan describes the primary statistical analysis for the REDEP study. The analyses described herein were defined prior to database lock and unblinding. Secondary analyses will be described in subsequent versions of this statistical analysis plan.

papers.title: Implementation of high-dose glucocorticoids and opioid consumption in the first 24 hours after elective hip and knee arthroplasty: a natural experiment study of 47,317 procedures in Eastern Denmark
papers.translated_title: 择期髋膝关节置换术后24小时内大剂量糖皮质激素的使用与阿片类药物消耗：丹麦东部47,317例手术的自然实验研究
papers.author: Laigaard, J.
papers.summary: Background: In Denmark, high-dose perioperative glucocorticoids were implemented stepwise for patients undergoing total hip arthroplasty (THA), total knee arthroplasty (TKA), and unicompartmental knee arthroplasty (UKA). We aimed to estimate the opioid-sparing effect of adding a single high dose of glucocorticoids to the analgesic regimen. Methods: In this prespecified analysis of a multicentre natural experiment using electronic health record data, we included all elective THA, TKA, or UKA procedures performed in Eastern Denmark from 2017-2025, with no exclusion criteria. At each centre, procedures before implementation of high-dose glucocorticoids served as controls, whereas procedures after implementation comprised the intervention group. A high dose was defined as [≥]16 mg or 0.2 mg/kg dexamethasone or [≥]80 mg methylprednisolone. The primary outcome was the adjusted between-group difference in 0-24h opioid consumption. The minimal important difference was 5 mg IV morphine equivalents. Secondary outcomes were maximum 0-10 numerical rating scale (NRS) pain score, incidence of opioid-related adverse events, hospital length of stay, and days alive and out of hospital at 30 days. Results: We analysed 47,317 procedures performed at nine centres: 13,010 controls and 34,307 in the intervention group. During the study period, five of nine centres implemented high-dose glucocorticoids for THA patients, two of eight for TKA/UKA patients. High-dose glucocorticoids were administered to 6% and 92% of patients before and after implementation, respectively. The implementation was associated with an adjusted mean reduction of 3.8 mg IV morphine equivalents (95% CI 3.3 to 4.3) and a 0.8-point lower maximum recorded pain score (99% CI 0.7 to 0.9) in the first 24 hours, with no statistically significant differences in the remaining outcomes. Conclusions: Implementation of high-dose glucocorticoids was associated with only a small drop in opioid consumption, below the minimal important difference. papers.title: CREBBP variants underlying Menke-Hennekam syndrome exhibit histone acetyltransferase hyperactivity with divergent phase behaviors

papers.summary: Menke-Hennekam syndrome (MKHK) is a neurodevelopmental disease characterized by specific pathogenic regions within the transcriptional coactivator CREB-binding protein (CREBBP). CREBBP regulates gene expression through histone acetyltransferase (HAT) activity and involves IDR-dependent transcriptional condensates. Although domain-specific phenotypes and distinct DNA methylation episignatures have been recognized in MKHK, the underlying molecular mechanisms remain widely unclear. In this study, we identified a recurrent missense variant, p.(R1868W) [R1868W]) and a novel splice variant r.5963_5969del,p.(Cys1723Thrfs*19) [C1723fs] in two families clinically diagnosed with MKHK and manifesting developmental delay, characteristic facial features, and growth impairment. R1868W and C1723fs exhibited increased auto-, nonhistone protein, and histone acetylation. Despite these shared enzymatic abnormalities, the variants promoted divergent disruption in liquid-liquid phase separation. The recurrent CBP-ID4 variant R1868W activated the formation of low-mobility aberrant nuclear condensates, whereas the C-terminal, truncating variant C1723fs, impaired condensate formation and showed diffuse nuclear localization. Treatment with the selective p300/CBP HAT inhibitor A485 partially restored condensate dynamics and fusion-relaxation behavior in R1868W. Furthermore, R1868W recruited BRD4 around condensates in an acetylation-dependent manner, which was suppressed by the BET inhibitor JQ1. Together, these findings suggest that aberrant condensate material properties arising from disrupted CREBBP IDR-dependent regulation play a critical role in the molecular pathogenesis of MKHK.

papers.title: Comparing the Phenotypic and Genetic Differences Between Autistic Regression and Autism Without Regression Using the SPARK Cohort

papers.summary: The biology of autistic regression (Autreg) remains poorly understood. We investigated Autreg's phenotypic and genetic landscape in 51 633 individuals from the SPARK cohort. We calculated the frequencies of parental-reported language regression and regression affecting social, play, toileting, and/or other developmental domains, and ages at skill regression and regain within SPARK. We compared developmental milestones, quantitative developmental measures, and selected other phenotypes in Autreg and autism without regression (Autnreg). Rare damaging coding variants and polygenic scores (PGS) in Autreg and Autnreg were compared using genome sequencing data. Rare variants were analyzed using the Transmission And De novo Association (TADA) framework in 1 107 Autreg and 974 Autnreg individuals, followed by pathway enrichment analysis. PGS for autism, attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder, epilepsy, and schizophrenia were initially compared. PGS validation was conducted in 14 001 Autnreg and 11 638 Autreg individuals using larger SPARK genotyping data. We identified regression in 43% of autistic individuals. Other regression occurred later than language regression, and 60% of skill regain occurred within two years. Autreg was associated with lower Vineland-3 Adaptive Behavior Composite scores (p<0.001) and >twofold increased odds of epilepsy and intellectual disability (p<0.001). TADA analysis highlighted genes involved in nucleotide catabolism, transcription, and focal adhesion, with PTEN emerging as a strong candidate for Autreg. Schizophrenia PGS explained 0.087% of variance in liability to regression among autistic individuals. In conclusion, Autreg was associated with increased neurodevelopmental morbidity. Schizophrenia PGS and rare variants explained a minimal fraction of its etiology.

papers.title: Cross-Sectional Study of Periodontal Oral Dental Foci of Infection (PODFI) in Medically Compromised Patients at Lille University Hospital
papers.translated_title: 里尔大学医院医学上脆弱患者牙周口腔牙源性感染灶（PODFI）的横断面研究
papers.author: Ribreux, S.
papers.summary: Oral dental foci of infection (ODFI), particularly those of periodontal origin, can trigger systemic inflammatory responses that may cause bacteraemia for medically compromised patients. Although guidelines recommend detection and elimination of these foci, precise data on the distribution of periodontal oral dental foci of infection (PODFI) risk within these populations remain scarce. This study aimed to describe periodontal sources of infection in medically compromised patients using a periodontal examination and follow-up form and a recently developed PODFI risk levels classification. This observational, retrospective, cross-sectional, single-center study evaluated medically compromised patients with periodontitis in the dental surgery department of the Lille University Hospital between September 2024 and September 2025. Periodontitis was diagnosed according to the 2017 Classification of Periodontal Diseases established at the 2017 World Workshop. The primary outcome was the distribution of PODFI risk levels (moderate, high, very high). Secondary outcomes aimed to describe periodontal conditions in a specific population of medically compromised patients. Thirty-nine patients were included in this study. Evaluation of PODFI risk (n = 34) revealed a predominance of moderate-risk profiles (67.6 %) and a significant proportion of high-risk profiles (32.4 %); no low-risk or very high-risk profiles were observed. Generalized periodontal inflammation was very common (92 %), with a median of 26 bleeding on probing (BOP) sites and 71 plaque-positive sites, showing a positive correlation (R = 0.52, p = 0.002). Severe and active forms of periodontitis predominated (n = 39), with 74.4 % of cases classified as stage III (28.2 %) or stage IV (46.2 %), and grade B was the most common (56.4 %), followed by grade C (38.5 %) (p = 0.025). Medically compromised patients have a high prevalence of severe and active periodontitis, with nearly one-third of them classified as being at high risk for infection. The recently developed periodontal oral dental foci of infection (PODFI) classification provides a structured and clinically relevant tool for stratifying infection risk and guiding treatment decisions. Prospective multicenter studies are needed to confirm the validity of these PODFI risk levels.
